[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- `packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:736` now unlinks a deal by updating only the section’s local `deals` state (`setDeals(...filter...)` at `:770`), but the classic person detail page still derives `dealSelectOptions` from parent `data.deals` at [`packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:249`](</home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:249>) and passes those stale options into [`ActivitiesSection`](</home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:804>). `ActivitiesSection` forwards them directly to the activity form at [`packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/ActivitiesSection.tsx:398`](</home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/ActivitiesSection.tsx:398>). After unlinking a deal from a person, the same page can still offer that now-unlinked deal in the Activities tab until a full reload, which lets users create activities against the wrong relationship. The fix needs a parent refresh or parent-state update when unlink succeeds.

Assumptions:
- I’m treating the classic person detail route as supported because this branch updates it directly. If that route is intentionally dead, this drops in severity.

Validation note:
- I attempted `yarn workspace @open-mercato/core test --runInBand src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx`, but this worktree is missing `packages/core/generated/*`, so Jest failed before executing assertions.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:747) now handles “remove from this record” by sending a normal deal update with either `personIds: []` or `companyIds: []`. In [deals.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/commands/deals.ts:337), the update command blindly resyncs the link tables and does not enforce that at least one person or company remains attached. If the current record is the last link, this branch creates an orphan deal, which conflicts with the customers-module contract that deals must stay linked to a person or company. The new tests in [DealsSection.test.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx:89) only cover multi-linked deals, so this case is not caught.

Assumption: the guide requirement that deals must remain linked is still in force. If so, this flow needs a last-association guard or a different fallback for that case.

Scoped validation note: I tried `yarn test src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx --runInBand`, but this worktree is missing `packages/core/generated`, and an existing baseline test with the same `#generated/*` mock pattern fails the same way, so I did not treat that Jest setup issue as branch-specific.

[reviewer-agent] Ready: No blocking issues found in the scoped changes to [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:743) or [deals.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/commands/deals.ts:303). The UI now removes only the current person/company association via `updateCrud`, and it routes the write through the existing guarded-mutation contract, which is consistent with the server-side partial-association update flow in `customers.deals.update`.

Verification note: the branch also adds focused `DealsSection` tests for person and company removal flows, but I could not execute them locally because the existing `@open-mercato/core` Jest setup in this worktree resolves `#generated/*` to a missing `packages/core/generated/*` directory before any test code runs. I reproduced the same failure on an unrelated baseline test that already mocks `#generated/entities.ids.generated`, so I do not consider that branch-blocking.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
1. Successful deal writes are now coupled to the follow-up detail reload, so a transient reload failure is surfaced as a failed mutation and can kick the user to the fatal error screen. The new awaits in [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:654), [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:733), and [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:778) all treat `onDataRefresh()` as part of the success path. On the legacy person page, [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:286) stores any reload failure in page-level `error`, and [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:472) renders the full error state whenever that flag is set. Result: the POST/PUT succeeds, but the user can still see an error toast, keep the dialog open, and lose the detail page. The refresh needs to be best-effort, not part of mutation success/failure.

2. The `loadData` refactor regresses same-component navigation between people because the “initial load done” ref is never reset for a new `id`. In [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:276), `initialLoadDoneRef` is sticky across record changes; then [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:283) skips `setIsLoading(true)` and [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:297) skips clearing stale data once the first load has happened. If the user navigates from one `/people/:id` page to another without a remount, the previous person can remain rendered while the new request is in flight, which the old effect-based loader did not do.

Validation: a direct scoped Jest run (`yarn workspace @open-mercato/core test --runInBand src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx`) did not execute because this worktree’s package-level Jest config could not resolve `#generated/entities.ids.generated`, so the review is based on the diff and touched-path behavior.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- Missing the required Playwright coverage for the new customer/company detail unlink flow. The branch changes end-user behavior in [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:743) and the person-detail wiring in [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.tsx:819), but the only added test is a jsdom unit test in [DealsSection.test.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx:89). There is no new or updated module-local Playwright spec under `packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/`, and the closest existing coverage, [TC-CRM-019.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-019.spec.ts:10), exercises the deal detail page rather than the customer/company detail tabs this fix changed. Given the explicit QA requirement in `.ai/qa/AGENTS.md` and `.ai/skills/integration-tests/SKILL.md`, this should add a self-contained `TC-CRM-*` Playwright test that removes a deal from the person/company detail page, verifies the deal still exists, and verifies only the association was removed.
Good idea, please fix tests though

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- High: [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:563), [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:754), [deals.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/commands/deals.ts:337) — the new unlink path can orphan a deal. Deals created from a person/company detail page start with only the current record attached, and the new remove payload just filters that id out. The update command then blindly syncs the remaining arrays. If the deal only had that one linked person/company, the record survives with zero associations, which violates the customers-module invariant that deals stay linked to a person or company and makes the deal disappear from both detail pages. The added coverage only exercises multi-linked deals: [TC-CRM-034.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-034.spec.ts:90) and [TC-CRM-034.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-034.spec.ts:137).
- Medium: [TC-CRM-034.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-034.spec.ts:29) — the new Playwright spec uses `page.locator('article')`. The QA guide for executable tests requires role/label/text/placeholder locators, so this is below the repo standard and more brittle than necessary.

Validation:
- `yarn workspace @open-mercato/core test --runInBand src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx` passed.
- `npx playwright test --config .ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-034.spec.ts --list` did not complete promptly because Playwright environment startup hung, so I did not get discovery/run output.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- High: The new orphan-check path in [deals.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/commands/deals.ts:359) queries `loadDealAssociations(em, record)` after scalar fields have already been mutated on the same `EntityManager` in [deals.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/commands/deals.ts:341). `packages/core/AGENTS.md` explicitly calls this out as unsafe unless wrapped in `withAtomicFlush(...)`, because a query before `flush()` can cause MikroORM to drop pending scalar updates. The new edit flow in [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:675) always sends `personIds` and `companyIds` alongside title/status/etc, so ordinary detail-page edits now hit this new branch and can silently persist only the association change while losing the scalar edits. This needs to load associations before mutating `record`, or be reworked into a `withAtomicFlush(...)` sequence.

Open questions / assumptions:
- I treated repo-wide build/test noise as out of scope and reviewed only the touched customers paths plus the adjacent tests required by the QA guides.

Validation:
- `npx jest --config packages/core/jest.config.cjs packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealForm.validation.test.ts packages/core/src/modules/customers/data/__tests__/validators.test.ts --runInBand` passed.
- `npx playwright test --config .ai/qa/tests/playwright.config.ts packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-034.spec.ts --list` discovered the 3 expected CRM scenarios. I did not run the full Playwright spec.

[reviewer-agent] Ready: No blocking findings in the current changes.

I reviewed the requested guides, then checked the touched behavior around [DealsSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/components/detail/DealsSection.tsx:743) and [deals.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/commands/deals.ts:113). The fix is coherent across layers: the detail-page unlink action now blocks orphaning before confirmation, and the command layer enforces the same invariant on create/update so API or stale-UI paths cannot leave a deal unassigned.

Scoped validation was clean for the low-level coverage added here: `yarn workspace @open-mercato/core test --runTestsByPath src/modules/customers/components/detail/__tests__/DealsSection.test.tsx src/modules/customers/data/__tests__/validators.test.ts` passed. The new Playwright spec at [TC-CRM-034.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0036/packages/core/src/modules/customers/__integration__/TC-CRM-034.spec.ts:63) is discoverable and follows the QA guidance with runtime-created fixtures and cleanup, but I could not execute it in this session because there was no running app or reusable ephemeral QA environment.
